info.notes: Made in January 2026. This item highlights the use of custom brush sculpting tools used within Blender. The highpoly sculpt is baked onto the model and the curvature is utilised to create glowing textures. This item acted as a prototype for characters weapons within my game. It also helped define a style
This styled Harpoon was created as part of an art challenge where the prompt was to create a weapon of the deep. It was fully modelled in Blender and textured within Substance Painter

Made in early 2026. This model was created to help with teaching a new course developed at TAFE where students have to create a golem character. This helped me better understand workflow techniques to better prepare for my lessons
This model was created as one of the anchoring assets in my game that would stand out. It has suitable topology for animation but at the moment only exists as a statue
Created for my personally developed game Leylines. This is a lower-tiered monster that could exist with others as part of a swarm. The model shows an attack animation.
This model was made for my independent game Leylines. The model is fully rigged and features an idle, walk, attack and death animation
This model showcased a stylysed texture made with a smart material in substance painter
